WITH ponderation AS (
  SELECT
    s.id AS synthese_id,
    a.id AS article_id,
    a.titre,
    a.url,
    a.date_publication,
    src.code AS source_code,
    src.nom AS source_nom,
    c.criticite,
    c.thematiques,
    s.tldr,
    s.contenu_synthese,
    s.citations,
    s.confiance,
    s.citations_verifiees,
    s.cout_euros,
    CASE c.criticite
      WHEN 'critique' THEN 100
      WHEN 'elevee' THEN 50
      WHEN 'moyenne' THEN 20
      WHEN 'faible' THEN 5
    END AS poids_criticite,
    CASE 
      WHEN src.code LIKE 'FR-ANSSI%' THEN 1.0
      WHEN src.code LIKE 'FR-CNIL%' THEN 1.0
      WHEN src.code LIKE 'FR-CERT%' THEN 1.0
      ELSE 0.6
    END AS poids_fiabilite,
    CASE 
      WHEN a.date_publication > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day' THEN 1.0
      WHEN a.date_publication > NOW() - INTERVAL '3 days' THEN 0.8
      WHEN a.date_publication > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 0.5
      WHEN a.date_publication > NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' THEN 0.3
      ELSE 0.2
    END AS poids_recence
  FROM syntheses s
  JOIN articles a ON a.id = s.article_id
  JOIN sources src ON src.id = a.source_id
  JOIN classifications c ON c.article_id = a.id
  WHERE s.synthese_impossible = FALSE
    AND a.date_publication > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
),
section_semaine AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    'actu_semaine' AS section,
    1 AS ordre_section,
    ROUND(
      (poids_criticite * poids_fiabilite * poids_recence * confiance)::numeric,
      2
    ) AS score_priorite
  FROM ponderation
  WHERE date_publication > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  ORDER BY (poids_criticite * poids_fiabilite * poids_recence * confiance) DESC,
           date_publication DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
section_mois AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    'recap_mois' AS section,
    2 AS ordre_section,
    ROUND(
      (poids_criticite * confiance)::numeric,
      2
    ) AS score_priorite
  FROM ponderation
  WHERE date_publication <= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
    AND date_publication > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
    AND article_id NOT IN (SELECT article_id FROM section_semaine)
  ORDER BY (poids_criticite * confiance) DESC,
           date_publication DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT * FROM section_semaine
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM section_mois
ORDER BY ordre_section ASC, score_priorite DESC;

INSERT INTO digests (
  type_digest,
  periode_debut,
  periode_fin,
  nb_articles_inclus,
  article_ids,
  contenu,
  statut,
  score_moyen,
  ponderation_details,
  cout_total_euros,
  sujet_email,
  date_generation
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.type_digest }}',
  '{{ $json.periode_debut }}',
  '{{ $json.periode_fin }}',
  {{ $json.nb_articles_inclus }},
  ARRAY[{{ $json.article_ids.join(',') }}]::integer[],
  $$ {{ $json.contenu }} $$,
  '{{ $json.statut }}',
  {{ $json.score_moyen }},
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.ponderation_details).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  {{ $json.cout_total_euros }},
  '{{ $json.sujet_email.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  NOW()
)
RETURNING id, type_digest, periode_debut, periode_fin, nb_articles_inclus, sujet_email, LENGTH(contenu) AS taille_html_chars;
